Record a native harness lifecycle event

Usage:
  pasture hook lifecycle [flags]
  pasture hook lifecycle [command]

Available Commands:
  context     Disclose and durably record the bounded lifecycle context for one native identity binding
  lineage     Materialize and print the committed occurrence lineage for one native identity binding
  list        List recorded lifecycle events
  manifest    Show the active lifecycle metamodel manifest and whether it is journaled
  orphans     Reclaim and count the payload blobs that no recorded occurrence names
  raw         Ingest a raw lifecycle event (imports and migration; not the default path)

Flags:
      --event string          Native event this generated hook is registered for (required)
      --harness string        Native harness whose payload is on standard input (required)
  -h, --help                  help for lifecycle
      --host-version string   Observed native host version to retain with this occurrence (required)

Global Flags:
      --db string          Path to the unified pasture SQLite database (env: PASTURE_DB_PATH, default: ~/.local/share/pasture/pasture.db)
      --format string      Output format: text or json (default "text")
      --namespace string   Namespace URI for created tasks (default: derived from git remote, then file:// of cwd)

Use "pasture hook lifecycle [command] --help" for more information about a command.
